label: SystemWorkModeConfig
info:
System Work Mode Config - Read & Write

Registers:
- 241: Work mode (Bit0-1: 10=battery first, 11=load first)
- 242: Export strategy (0=selling_first, 1=zero_export_to_load, 2=zero_export_to_ct)
- 243: Max sell power
- 245: Solar sell enable
- 246: TOU enable + days (bit field)
- 248-253: TOU time points 1-6
- 254-259: TOU power 1-6
- 260-265: TOU voltage 1-6
- 266-271: TOU capacity 1-6
- 272-277: TOU charge enable 1-6 (bit field)
- 278: Grid peak shaving (Bit4-5)
- 279: Force off-grid (Bit2-3)
- 291: Grid peak shaving power
